arXiv:2605.10934v1 [cs.LG] 2026 年 5 月 11 日arXiv:2605.10934v1 [cs.LG] 11 May 2026

Lévy 过程驱动的 SDE 的变分推理Variational Inference for Lévy Process-Driven SDEs
通过神经倾斜via Neural Tilting

Yaman Kındap1, Manfred Opper2, Benjamin Dupuis3, Umut Şimşekli3, Tolga Birdal1
1Imperial College London, UK    2Technical University of Berlin, Germany
3INRIA, CNRS, Département d’Informatique de l’Ecole Normale Supérieure / PSL, France
摘要Abstract

对极端事件和重尾现象进行建模对于在金融、气候科学和安全关键型人工智能等领域构建可靠的预测系统至关重要。虽然 Lévy 过程为捕获跳跃和重尾提供了一个自然的数学框架，但 Lévy 驱动的随机微分方程 (SDE) 的贝叶斯推理仍然难以用现有方法处理：蒙特卡洛方法很严格，但缺乏可扩展性，而神经变分推理方法很有效，但依赖于无法捕获不连续性的高斯假设。我们通过在 Lévy 驱动的 SDE 中引入用于变分推理的神经指数倾斜框架来解决这种紧张关系。我们的方法通过使用神经网络对 Lévy 度量进行指数级重新加权来构建灵活的变分族。这种参数化保留了底层进程的跳转结构，同时保持计算上的易处理性。为了实现有效的推理，我们开发了一种二次神经参数化，可以产生倾斜测量的封闭式归一化、有利于模拟的稳定过程的条件高斯表示，以及用于可扩展优化的对称感知蒙特卡洛估计器。根据经验，我们证明该方法可以准确地捕获跳跃动态，并在基于高斯的变分方法失败的情况下，在合成数据集和真实数据集上产生可靠的后验推理。Modelling extreme events and heavy-tailed phenomena is central to building reliable predictive systems in domains such as finance, climate science, and safety-critical AI. While Lévy processes provide a natural mathematical framework for capturing jumps and heavy tails, Bayesian inference for Lévy-driven stochastic differential equations (SDEs) remains intractable with existing methods: Monte Carlo approaches are rigorous but lack scalability, whereas neural variational inference methods are efficient but rely on Gaussian assumptions that fail to capture discontinuities. We address this tension by introducing a neural exponential tilting framework for variational inference in Lévy-driven SDEs. Our approach constructs a flexible variational family by exponentially reweighting the Lévy measure using neural networks. This parametrization preserves the jump structure of the underlying process while remaining computationally tractable. To enable efficient inference, we develop a quadratic neural parametrization that yields closed-form normalization of the tilted measure, a conditional Gaussian representation for stable processes that facilitates simulation, and symmetry-aware Monte Carlo estimators for scalable optimization. Empirically, we demonstrate that the method accurately captures jump dynamics and yields reliable posterior inference in regimes where Gaussian-based variational approaches fail, on both synthetic and real-world datasets.

1 简介Introduction

现实世界的随机系统，从金融市场到气候动态和 安全关键型人工智能，生成观察结果，表现出突然的不连续性、不对称冲击，以及 概率按照幂律衰减的极端事件Real-world stochastic systems, from financial markets to climate dynamics and safety-critical AI, generate observations exhibit sudden discontinuities, asymmetric shocks, and extreme events whose probability decays as a power lawx−αx^{-\alpha}而不是 呈指数增长。这种重尾结构是许多重要的决定性属性 现象，而不是异常偏离高斯性。近似它的模型 因此，高斯噪声在极端情况下会被系统地错误校准，其中 错误的成本是最高的。这门完整课程的自然数学语言 随机行为的理论是rather than exponentially. This heavy-tailed structure is a defining property of many consequential phenomena, not an anomalous departure from Gaussianity. Models that approximate it with Gaussian noise are therefore systematically miscalibrated at the extremes, where the cost of error is highest. The natural mathematical language for this full class of stochastic behaviour is the theory of无限可分 分布infinitely divisible distributions以及相关的 Lévy 流程，构成了完整的 具有独立且固定增量的过程族and associated Lévy processes, which form the complete family of processes with independent and stationary increments(Gnedenko and Kolmogorov, 1968; Ken-Iti, 1999)。对 Lévy 流程驱动中的潜在轨迹提供易于处理的近似贝叶斯推理 因此，随机微分方程 (SDE) 将产生一个有原则的、 不确定性感知框架，用于对数据生成过程偏离高斯性的任何领域的时间动态进行建模。. Providing tractable approximate Bayesian inference over latent trajectories in Lévy process-driven stochastic differential equations (SDEs) would therefore yield a principled, uncertainty-aware framework for modelling temporal dynamics across any domain where the data-generating process departs from Gaussianity.

神经 SDE 和 ODE 方法通过以下方式改变了连续时间序列建模： 提供在标准上具有竞争力的端到端可区分、可扩展的框架 基准Neural SDE and ODE approaches have transformed continuous-time sequence modelling by providing end-to-end differentiable, scalable frameworks competitive on standard benchmarks(Chen et al., 2018; Tzen and Raginsky, 2019; Kidger et al., 2020; Opper, 2019; Daems et al., 2025)，以及最近的扩展，例如 Neural Jump SDE, with recent extensions such as Neural Jump SDEs(Jia and Benson, 2019)和神经 MJDand Neural MJD(Gao et al., 2025)明确地 结合不连续性并在具有突变的时间序列上取得良好的结果 变化。深度时间序列预测器，包括 DeepAR、DLinear 和 N-HiTSexplicitly incorporating discontinuities and achieving strong results on time series with abrupt changes. Deep time-series forecasters, including DeepAR, DLinear, and N-HiTS(Salinas et al., 2020; Zeng et al., 2023; Challu et al., 2023), 达到 通过灵活的数据驱动，在标准基准上实现最先进的性能 无需任何微分方程结构的参数化。然而所有这些方法 都有一个根本性的限制。他们对噪声（包括跳跃幅度）进行了建模 轻尾分布并通过以下方式拟合其参数 最大可能性。这使得每个模型都经过校准的参数噪声结构 平均行为，产生系统性过度自信的预测 极端分位数，重尾现象直接暴露的失效模式，如图所示, achieve state-of-the-art performance on standard benchmarks through flexible, data-driven parametrizations without any differential equation structure. Yet all of these methods share a fundamental limitation. They model noise, including jump magnitudes, with light-tailed distributions and fit their parameters by maximum likelihood. This commits each model to a parametric noise structure calibrated to average behaviour, yielding predictions that are systematically overconfident at extreme quantiles, the failure mode that heavy-tailed phenomena directly expose, as shown inFig.˜1.

这就留下了一个关键的差距：不存在可处理的框架来对 Lévy 驱动的 SDE 的潜在动态进行后验推理，从而使跳跃结构成为固定的参数假设，而不是从数据中推断出的潜在量。现有的随机过程变分推理（VI）方法通过布朗测度变化公式获得易于处理的路径空间目标，但这些方法无法对 Lévy 测度产生后验推理。连续变分过程相对于跳跃过程而言是奇异的，并且跳跃扩散中的布朗漂移校正使跳跃定律保持不变。我们通过学习先前 Lévy 度量的神经指数倾斜来缩小这一差距，保留神经方法的端到端可微性和可扩展性，同时产生易于处理的变分后验，对 ELBO 具有明确的跳跃和漂移贡献。This leaves a critical gap: no tractable framework exists for posterior inference over the latent dynamics of a Lévy-driven SDE, leaving jump structure as a fixed parametric assumption rather than a latent quantity to be inferred from data. Existing variational inference (VI) methods for stochastic processes obtain tractable path-space objectives through Brownian change-of-measure formulas, but these cannot produce posterior inference over the Lévy measure. Continuous variational processes are singular with respect to jump processes, and Brownian drift corrections in jump-diffusions leave the jump law unchanged. We close this gap by learning a neural exponential tilt of the prior Lévy measure, preserving the end-to-end differentiability and scalability of neural methods while yielding a tractable variational posterior with explicit jump and drift contributions to the ELBO.我们的贡献是Our contributions are:

  • •

    A Lévy 驱动的 SDE 的路径空间 VI 框架path-space VI framework for Lévy-driven SDEs导出最优马尔可夫变分后验作为指数倾斜 先前的利维措施。that derives the optimal Markov variational posterior as an exponential tilt of the prior Lévy measure.

  • •

    神经倾斜Neural Tilting：倾斜的二次神经参数化 保留灵活的状态和时间相关的后跳的函数 行为，同时产生封闭形式的标准化常数。: a quadratic neural parametrisation of the tilting function that preserves flexible state- and time-dependent posterior jump behaviour while yielding closed-form normalising constants.

  • •

    高效仿真和 ELBO 优化算法Efficient simulation and ELBO optimisation algorithms那些利用 稳定过程的条件高斯表示和对称性 他们的征税措施。that exploit the conditionally Gaussian representation of stable processes and the symmetry of their Lévy measures.

  • •

    对合成数据集和真实世界数据集的实证验证表明 框架恢复了重尾跳跃动力学并改进了尾部校准 高斯基线失败。Empirical validation on synthetic and real-world datasets showing that the framework recovers heavy-tailed jump dynamics and improves tail calibration where Gaussian baselines fail.

随机过程的变分推理（六）Variational inference (VI) for stochastic processes

随机过程的 VI 通常依赖于标准的吉尔萨诺夫定理，该定理通过改变布朗 SDE 下的漂移，提供路径测量之间易于处理的 Radon-Nikodym 导数，从而产生布朗运动的封闭形式的二次 ELBOVI for stochastic processes typically relies on the standard Girsanov theorem, which provides a tractable Radon–Nikodym derivative between path measures by changing the drift under a Brownian SDE, yielding a quadratic ELBO in closed form for Brownian motionOpper (2019)及其小数对应项and its fractional counterpartDaems et al. (2024)，使用神经近似后验的黑盒变体, with black-box variants using neural approximate posteriorsRyder et al. (2018); Tzen and Raginsky (2019)。 对于 Lévy 驱动的 SDE，基于 Fokker-Planck 的变分方法已用于估计指定条件下的漂移函数. For Lévy-driven SDEs, Fokker–Planck-based variational methods have been used to estimate drift functions under specifiedα\alpha- 噪音稳定-stable noiseDai et al. (2022)，但他们的目标是漂移恢复，而不是对潜在路径或 Lévy 度量的后验推理。由此产生的局限性是结构性的：现有的随机过程 VI 方法没有提供用于学习后重尾跳跃行为的变分机制。, but their objective is drift recovery rather than posterior inference over latent paths or the Lévy measure. The resulting limitation is structural: existing stochastic process VI methods provide no variational mechanism for learning posterior heavy-tailed jump behaviour.

3 背景Background

定义3.1Definition 3.1 （莱维过程(Lévy process(Applebaum, 2009)).

让Let(Ω,ℱ,ℙ)(\Omega,\mathcal{F},\mathbb{P})是带有过滤的概率空间be a probability space with filtration{ℱt}t≥0\{\mathcal{F}_{t}\}_{t\geq 0}。适应随机过程. An adapted stochastic process{Lt:t≥0}\{L_{t}:t\geq 0\}值在with values inℝd\mathbb{R}^{d}是一个is a莱维法Lévy process如果它满足： (i)if it satisfies: (i)L0=0L_{0}=0例如， (ii) 独立增量，(iii) 平稳增量，以及 (iv) 随机连续性。 增量的平稳性和独立性表明 Lévy 过程可能是 解释为连续时间内的一系列随机游走a.s., (ii) independent increments, (iii) stationary increments, and (iv) stochastic continuity. The stationarity and independence of increments suggest that Lévy processes may be interpreted as a family of random walks in continuous time(Bertoin, 1996; Ken-Iti, 1999; Cont and Tankov, 2003).

备注3.2Remark 3.2 （与无限可分分布的连接）(Connection to infinitely divisible distributions).

在任意固定时刻，Lévy 过程的类与 无限可分分布 (IDD)，是概率度量At any fixed time, the class of Lévy processes corresponds one-to-one with infinitely divisible distributions (IDDs), which are probability measuresμ\mu on ℝd\mathbb{R}^{d}那个 可以写成that can be written as thenn折叠卷积-fold convolutionμ=μn∗⋯∗μn\mu=\mu_{n}*\cdots*\mu_{n}对于任何 正整数for any positive integernn。这封信提供了接触富裕家庭的机会，包括 高斯（平滑扩散）、泊松（离散事件）和稳定过程 （自相似，重尾）。布朗运动是唯一具有以下特征的 Lévy 过程 连续的样品路径；所有其他设置都会产生跳跃扩散 流程. This correspondence provides access to a rich family including Gaussian (smooth diffusion), Poisson (discrete events), and stable processes (self-similar, heavy-tailed). Brownian motion is the only Lévy process with continuous sample paths; all other settings yield jump-diffusion processes(Ken-Iti, 1999).

5 实验Experiments

我们在两种都表现出明显重尾动态的设置上验证了我们的框架：（i）具有真实参数的合成数据和（ii） 具有挑战性的现实世界预测任务。We validate our framework on two settings that both exhibit pronounced heavy-tailed dynamics: (i) synthetic data with ground-truth parameters and (ii) challenging real-world forecasting task.

6 结论Conclusion

我们为 Lévy 驱动的 SDE 引入了变分推理框架，其中 近似后验表示为倾斜的 Lévy 过程，其中先验跳跃 通过学习的指数因子和布朗分量重新加权的测量 标准分数修正。尽管我们的实验侧重于稳定过程， 测量变化结构适用于更广泛的 Lévy 过程， 在一般非高斯模型中开辟了可扩展后验推理的途径 跳跃结构。二次神经参数化是一种计算设备 使这个易于处理，产生封闭形式的归一化常数和精确的拒绝 倾斜跳跃定律的采样器。We introduced a variational inference framework for Lévy-driven SDEs in which the approximate posterior is expressed as a tilted Lévy process, with the prior jump measure reweighted by a learned exponential factor and the Brownian component acquiring the standard score correction. Although our experiments focus on stable processes, the change-of-measure construction applies to the broader class of Lévy processes, opening a route to scalable posterior inference in models with general non-Gaussian jump structure. The quadratic neural parametrisation is the computational device that makes this tractable, yielding closed-form normalising constants and an exact rejection sampler for the tilted jump law.

该框架在所有实验设置中提供Across all experimental settings the framework delivers22–4×4\timesCRPS 对合成系统高斯基线的改进，CRPS improvements over Gaussian baselines on synthetic systems, a21%21\%改进 金融数据次优概率模型和最强尾部表现 在单变量和多变量预测中的每个跳跃 CRPS 阈值。 参数恢复证实，如果没有正确指定的重尾噪声模型， 漂移吸收罕见的大幅度偏移作为虚假曲率，扭曲 即使整体拟合看起来合理，也能推断出动态。improvement over the next-best probabilistic model on financial data, and the strongest tail performance at every jump-CRPS threshold in both univariate and multivariate forecasting. Parameter recovery confirms that without a correctly specified heavy-tailed noise model, the drift absorbs rare large-amplitude excursions as spurious curvature, distorting inferred dynamics even when the overall fit appears reasonable.

局限性和未来的工作Limitations and future work

二次参数化缓和了后尾并且可能不足以代表不对称 或多模态跳跃定律；更丰富的基于流的倾斜功能是自然的下一步。 我们的推导使用时间离散的测量变化参数；完全正式处理的可积分条件在The quadratic parametrisation tempers posterior tails and may under-represent asymmetric or multi-modal jump laws; richer flow-based tilting functions are a natural next step. Our derivation uses a time-discretised change-of-measure argument; integrability conditions for a fully formal treatment are discussed inRem.˜A.1。多元公式目前假设独立的稳定维度；合并 Lévy copula 将允许对跨维度尾部依赖性进行显式建模。稳定性指标. The multivariate formulation currently assumes independent stable dimensions; incorporating Lévy copulas would allow cross-dimensional tail dependence to be modelled explicitly. The stability indexα\alpha通过网格搜索固定； ELBO 内的联合估计仍是未来的工作。is fixed by grid search; joint estimation within the ELBO remains future work.

第 1 步：最佳转换比Step 1: Optimal transition ratio

我们在以下约束条件下最小化 KL 散度：We minimise the KL divergence subject to the constraint thatQQ对应于一个 有效的马尔可夫过程。查普曼-柯尔莫哥洛夫方程需要corresponds to a valid Markov process. The Chapman–Kolmogorov equations require

qt+Δ​t​(x′)=∫qt+Δ​t,t​(x′|x)​qt​(x)​d​x.q_{t+\Delta t}(x^{\prime})=\int q_{t+\Delta t,t}(x^{\prime}|x)\,q_{t}(x)\,\mathop{}\!\mathrm{d}x.

拉格朗日乘子简介Introducing Lagrange multipliersϕt​(x′)\phi_{t}(x^{\prime})对于每个约束并取 增强目标的函数导数关于for each constraint and taking the functional derivative of the augmented objective with respect toqt+Δ​t,t​(x′|x)q_{t+\Delta t,t}(x^{\prime}|x)产生一阶条件yields the first-order condition

ln⁡qt+Δ​t,t​(x′|x)pt+Δ​t,t​(x′|x)=ϕt​(x′)−ln⁡Zt​(x),\ln\frac{q_{t+\Delta t,t}(x^{\prime}|x)}{p_{t+\Delta t,t}(x^{\prime}|x)}=\phi_{t}(x^{\prime})-\ln Z_{t}(x),

哪里whereZt​(x)=𝔼p​[eϕt​(Xt+Δ​t)∣x]Z_{t}(x)=\mathbb{E}_{p}\!\left[e^{\phi_{t}(X_{t+\Delta t})}\mid x\right]是 约束施加的归一化常数。求幂给出最优 转变比is the normalising constant imposed by the constraint. Exponentiating gives the optimal transition ratioEq.˜16.

第 2 步：证明Step 2: Proof of˜4.1

我们从最优转换比率推导出后验生成器。对于任何测试 功能We derive the posterior generator from the optimal transition ratio. For any test functionGG，后验生成器定义为, the posterior generator is defined by

𝔼q​[G​(Xt+Δ​t)∣x]=G​(x)+Δ​t​ℒtQ​G​(x)+o​(Δ​t).\mathbb{E}_{q}\!\left[G(X_{t+\Delta t})\mid x\right]=G(x)+\Delta t\,\mathcal{L}^{Q}_{t}G(x)+o(\Delta t).

使用最佳转换比率Using the optimal transition ratioEq.˜16，我们还可以写 该期望与先前期望的比率：, we can also write this expectation as a ratio of prior expectations:

𝔼q​[G​(Xt+Δ​t)∣x]=𝔼p​[eϕt​(Xt+Δ​t)​G​(Xt+Δ​t)∣x]𝔼p​[eϕt​(Xt+Δ​t)∣x].\mathbb{E}_{q}\!\left[G(X_{t+\Delta t})\mid x\right]=\frac{\mathbb{E}_{p}\!\left[e^{\phi_{t}(X_{t+\Delta t})}G(X_{t+\Delta t})\mid x\right]}{\mathbb{E}_{p}\!\left[e^{\phi_{t}(X_{t+\Delta t})}\mid x\right]}.

应用先前的发电机扩展Applying the prior generator expansion𝔼p​[G​(Xt+Δ​t)∣x]=G​(x)+Δ​t​ℒtP​G​(x)+o​(Δ​t)\mathbb{E}_{p}[G(X_{t+\Delta t})\mid x]=G(x)+\Delta t\,\mathcal{L}^{P}_{t}G(x)+o(\Delta t)分子和分母：to numerator and denominator:

For Gaussian SDEs the drift correction𝑫​∇ϕt\bm{D}\nabla\phi_{t}等于分数 边际密度，实现学习逆向过程。类似的公式为 Lévy 系统通过以下方式取代跳跃测量equals the score of the marginal density, enabling learned reverse processes. A generative model built on the variational family of˜4.1结构上会有所不同：相反的过程将带来状态条件倾斜 跳跃测量would differ structurally: the reverse process would carry a state-conditioned tilted jump measureeϕt​(x+𝒚)−ϕt​(x)​ν​(d​𝒚)e^{\phi_{t}(x+\bm{y})-\phi_{t}(x)}\,\nu(\mathop{}\!\mathrm{d}\bm{y})，所以跳跃定律本身 适应当前状态，而不是保持由修正的固定各向同性噪声 学会了漂移。, so the jump law itself adapts to the current state rather than remaining a fixed isotropic noise corrected by a learnt drift.

在联合设置中（In the joint setting (σ≠0\sigma\neq 0), 布朗漂移修正), the Brownian drift correction𝐃​∇ϕt​(Xt)\bm{D}\nabla\phi_{t}(X_{t})和跳跃倾斜因子and the jump tilting factoreϕt​(Xt+𝐲)−ϕt​(Xt)e^{\phi_{t}(X_{t}+\bm{y})-\phi_{t}(X_{t})}两者都是由相同的势能决定的are both determined by the same potentialϕt\phi_{t}。这种耦合是结构性结果. G.1 挂钟训练时间Wall-clock training time

为了给出计算成本的实际意义，我们报告了代表性的 在单个 NVIDIA GH200 Grace–Hopper GPU 上测量的挂钟训练时间。 对于合成的 实验，根据数据集实现报告时间；对于金融方面的 实验中，每个滚动训练和预测窗口都会报告时间。的 TS 和 Gaussian SDE 模型使用相同的优化协议， 因此它们的运行时间可以直接比较并隔离额外成本 重尾后验推理。其余基线包括为 上下文，尽管它们解决不同的优化问题并且属于 不同的模型类。To give a practical sense of the computational cost, we report representative wall-clock training times measured on a single NVIDIA GH200 Grace–Hopper GPU. For the synthetic experiments, times are reported per dataset realisation; for the financial experiments, times are reported per rolling train-and-forecast window. The TS and Gaussian SDE models use the same optimisation protocol, so their runtimes are directly comparable and isolate the additional cost of heavy-tailed posterior inference. The remaining baselines are included as context, though they solve different optimisation problems and belong to different model classes.

TS 相对于高斯 SDE 的额外成本在整个过程中是一致的 设置并反映倾斜 Lévy 度量采样的开销 并估计跳跃对 ELBO 的贡献。在合成环境中， TS 约为The additional cost of TS relative to the Gaussian SDE is consistent across settings and reflects the overhead of sampling from the tilted Lévy measure and estimating the jump contribution to the ELBO. In the synthetic setting, TS is approximately5×5\times比高斯 SDE 慢，同时保持 在两个漂移家族中都高度稳定。在金融领域，单变量 TS 模型 大约需要slower than the Gaussian SDE while remaining highly stable across both drift families. In finance, the univariate TS model requires approximately8484每个滚动窗口的分钟数，增加到 大约minutes per rolling window, increasing to approximately247247分钟在minutes in thed=10d=10多变量设置。这个缩放比例是 与模拟和优化重尾跳跃的额外成本一致 更高维度的结构。multivariate setting. This scaling is consistent with the added cost of simulating and optimising heavy-tailed jump structure in higher dimension.

尽管 TS 比面向预测的基线慢得多，例如 DLinear、N-HiTS 和 Neural MJD，这些模型不执行后验 对 Lévy 驱动的潜在路径度量的推断。因此我们认为 与高斯 SDE 的运行时比较作为信息最丰富的同类 衡量重尾跳跃动力学建模的计算成本。Although TS is substantially slower than forecasting-oriented baselines such as DLinear, N-HiTS, and Neural MJD, these models do not perform posterior inference over a Lévy-driven latent path measure. We therefore view the runtime comparison with the Gaussian SDE as the most informative like-for-like measure of the computational price of modelling heavy-tailed jump dynamics.

G.2 优化细节Optimisation details

TS 和高斯 SDE 模型都使用相同的神经漂移参数化Both TS and Gaussian SDE models use the same neural drift parametrisationftθf_{t}^{\theta}：宽度的单隐藏层 MLP: a one-hidden-layer MLP of width3232。我们发现增加 漂移宽度持续降低了预测性能，这表明 小漂移网络通过防止漂移充当有效的正则器 吸收应归因于潜在噪声的变异性 过程。. We found that increasing the drift width consistently degraded predictive performance, suggesting that a small drift network acts as an effective regulariser by preventing the drift from absorbing variability that should instead be attributed to the latent noise process.

优化器和梯度稳定Optimiser and gradient stabilisation

TS 模型使用 RMSProp 进行训练，没有学习率衰减。学习中 速率设置为The TS model is trained with RMSProp and no learning-rate decay. The learning rate is set to10−410^{-4}在综合和单变量金融实验中， 并到in the synthetic and univariate financial experiments, and to10−310^{-3}在多元金融实验中。我们发现缺席 衰减在实践中很重要：随着衰减，重尾的组合 蒙特卡罗噪声和已经保守的二阶矩归一化常常导致 在训练后期变得太小的更新。与亚当相比 相似的学习率，RMSProp 产生了实质上更稳定的优化， 而亚当经常导致明显的振荡。一个看似合理的 解释是，在重尾蒙特卡洛噪声下，一阶动量 放大罕见但非常大的梯度偏移而不是抑制它们， 而 RMSProp 的二阶矩归一化则更为保守。in the multivariate financial experiment. We found the absence of decay important in practice: with decay, the combination of heavy-tailed Monte Carlo noise and already conservative second-moment normalisation often led to updates that became too small late in training. Compared with Adam at similar learning rates, RMSProp produced materially more stable optimisation, whereas Adam frequently led to pronounced oscillations. A plausible explanation is that under heavy-tailed Monte Carlo noise, first-moment momentum amplifies rare but very large gradient excursions instead of damping them, while RMSProp’s second-moment normalisation is more conservative.

高斯 SDE 和所有剩余基准均使用 Adam 进行训练 学习率The Gaussian SDE and all remaining benchmarks are trained with Adam using learning rate10−410^{-4}和指数衰减因子and exponential decay factor0.950.95.

此外，TS 在 RMSProp 更新。对于每个参数张量In addition, TS uses a custom layerwise gradient rescaling step before the RMSProp update. For each parameter tensorgg，我们通过计算其稳健规模 经验的, we compute its robust scale via the empirical0.950.95-分位数-quantile of|g||g|，并与均方根进行比较 规范, and compare it with the root-mean-square norm‖g‖2/|g|\|g\|_{2}/\sqrt{|g|}。然后张量重新缩放. The tensor is then rescaled by

g←g/max⁡(1,‖g‖2/|g|q0.95​(|g|)+ε).g\leftarrow{g}\,/\,{\max\!\left(1,\,\frac{\|g\|_{2}/\sqrt{|g|}}{q_{0.95}(|g|)+\varepsilon}\right)}.

这种变换保留了坐标内的相对大小 图层，与坐标剪切不同，但是当整体 分层范数由少数极端条目主导。根据经验， 这对于 TS 目标的稳定优化非常重要，其 重尾跳跃样本可能会引起偶尔的梯度尖峰。我们诠释 该方法是无裁剪和硬裁剪之间的稳健折衷：它 保留方向信息，同时减少罕见的影响， 不成比例的大梯度。This transformation preserves the relative magnitudes of coordinates within a layer, unlike coordinatewise clipping, but suppresses updates when the overall layerwise norm is dominated by a small number of extreme entries. Empirically, this was important for stable optimisation of the TS objective, whose heavy-tailed jump samples can induce occasional gradient spikes. We interpret the method as a robust compromise between no clipping and hard clipping: it retains directional information while reducing the influence of rare, disproportionately large gradients.
